verdict_line: Revenue up 13% with the operating ratio 90 basis points worse on both measures, and reported EPS down 14%. A three-nation network is a data-integration problem — but no technology owner has been identified.

thesis.text: Growth is not converting to efficiency. Q2 2026 revenue $4.2 billion (+13%) against a reported operating ratio of 64.6% (worse by 90bps) and a core adjusted OR of 61.6% (also worse by 90bps).
The GAAP-to-adjusted gap is where integration cost still lives. Reported diluted EPS fell 14% to $1.15 while core adjusted diluted EPS rose 13% to $1.27, three years after the CP-KCS merger closed.
The three-nation network is the differentiator and the complexity. Canada-US-Mexico single-line service means customs, currency and three regulatory regimes across one operating plan.
The open question is ownership. No senior technology executive has been identified for CPKC in this pass. Until there is a named buyer, this stays QUALIFY rather than PURSUE.

exhibits.title: Q2 2026 performance
exhibits.headline: Record revenue and a worsening operating ratio on both reported and core adjusted measures.
exhibits.body_html: Revenue $4.16 billion (+13% from $3.7 billion) with revenue ton-miles up 4%. Net income $1,024 million, from $1,234 million. Reported diluted EPS $1.15 (−14%), core adjusted diluted EPS $1.27 (+13%). Fuel expense rose to $618 million from $405 million. The dividend was raised to $0.268 per share from $0.228. Management reaffirmed double-digit earnings growth for 2026 and reported record operating metrics in train speed, dwell and locomotive productivity. President and CEO: Keith Creel.
exhibits.sowhat: A railroad running Precision Scheduled Railroading whose operating ratio degrades during a volume upcycle has a cost-structure question it has not answered. That is the wedge — the same one that works at CN, framed as decision automation rather than headcount.

financials.basis: Verified from primary filings. Quarters shown as a dash could not be read from a primary source in this pass and are deliberately left empty rather than estimated.
